close_reason: added trait doc for singleton idempotency contract + concurrent-safe test
description: vacation.rs handle_vacation_set has a TOCTOU race: two concurrent requests hitting NotFound both call create_object. The trait comment says backends MUST make this idempotent but there is no trait method contract, no test, and MemoryBackend's Mutex masks the race. Need: trait-level doc + a test that verifies MemoryBackend is safe under concurrent access. Source: JMAP-bx3z.6 review finding.
title: VacationResponse upsert: document and test idempotency requirement for concurrent create
